name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a main agreement covering a provider's AI services, including model training, data use, and AI-specific restrictions.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement governing a provider's handling of protected health information (PHI).

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a customer's subscription to a provider's cloud-hosted software service.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms for processing personal data on a customer's behalf, covering controller/processor roles, subprocessors and security.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement under which a design partner gets early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Standard Terms
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA protecting confidential information shared by both parties.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement - Cover Page
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA capturing the purpose, term and party details.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Terms for a business partnership in which each party performs agreed obligations, such as co-marketing or referrals.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Terms for a customer's time-limited trial of a product before committing to a full agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Terms for services delivered under statements of work, including change orders, deliverables and acceptance.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Uptime and support response commitments, with remedies, supplementing a main service agreement.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Terms for licensing software to a customer, including user accounts, usage data and open source software.
